publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.4 makes erasing a person also remove them from your Business team list and keep them off it: if your Business sends an update that lists an erased person again, they stay off the list, and people you erased on 0.5.3 or earlier drop off the list at your next Business update. Erasing one person no longer touches another person's agent records when their email addresses end alike (erasing al@ no longer redacts sal@). The pinned @runeditrun/rer is now 0.2.107. One additive migration (0089) adds one table of markers that carry no name or address and changes nothing already stored; no new required settings; update an existing checkout with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Back up before upgrading. Known issues: restoring an installation archive does not bring back the list of erased people, so a Business that pairs again after a restore and still lists an erased person could invite them again; a company that has signed an agent policy but never sent company settings is treated as running, so its feed answers with an empty page (no token or decision is shared); rer deploy --dry-run prints its closing block twice; a response body over 64 KiB still fails the check, so monitor a smaller page such as a health endpoint. The product screenshot was taken on 0.4.0, before the console changes of 0.5.0, 0.5.1, 0.5.2, 0.5.3 and 0.5.4. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png
